text:
anya: heads up — onboarding Mistral-v2-7B produced a weird perf regression on long-context workloads. latency jumps after ~1024 tokens, and kv cache hit rate drops to 0.

sam: repro steps?

anya: quick summary: HF config for the model doesn't include rotary_scaling or rope_alpha fields we expect. our kernel selector picked a ROPE-optimized kernel but the kv dims coming out of the conversion script were permuted (safetensors metadata mismatch). result = cache keys don't match so we bypass the fast-path.

miguel: ouch. can you paste the profiling snippet?

anya: attaching top lines from the trace:

```
# perf trace (simplified)
2026-03-18 14:12:03.123 runtime: select_kernel -> kernel:rope_optimized_v2 (estimated 0.6ms)
2026-03-18 14:12:03.124 runtime: kv_lookup -> miss (expected shape [12,64,256] got [64,12,256])
2026-03-18 14:12:03.124 runtime: fallback -> generic_kv_path (3.8ms)
2026-03-18 14:12:03.127 net: end-to-end latency 6.2ms -> 18.6ms at seq=2048
```

jie: that shape swap looks like an axis order issue from the conversion script (dim ordering vs HF rafters). did we log any warnings during conversion?

evan: infra-bot reported safetensors metadata parsed OK, but we only validate dtype and tensor shapes (no axis semantics). infra-bot: conversion_job_4721 finished: warnings=1, errors=0.

sam: can you paste the conversion snippet you used?

anya: here — our light conversion in deploy-scripts:

```bash
python convert.py --input model.safetensors --out redwood-mistralv2 --map kv -> k,v --permute "(0,2,1)" 
```

# that permute was a guess to match old loaders and probably wrong.

miguel: ok two things: 1) we need a quick runtime guard so kernel selection checks actual kv dims before choosing the rope kernel; 2) a small unit check in conversion that validates head*kv_dim matches expected embedding dims.

sam: agree. low-risk patch: runtime check in kernel_selector: if kernel == rope_optimized && kv_shape != expected -> force_generic and emit a one-time warning metric. i'll draft PR.

jie: for conversion script: add a safetensors metadata header check and a small heuristic: if permute leads to head count mismatch, try other common permutations and pick the one where head*head_dim == hidden_size. if none match, fail loudly.

evan: also add an eval harness run that hits seqlen 512/1024/2048 to catch regressions in CI. small perf profile job should run on dedicated infra.

anya: i ran a quick A/B: with kernel guard, 2048 latency drops from 18.6ms -> 7.0ms (expected). with corrected permute, kv cache hit restores and throughput normalizes.

miguel: can we add a metric that correlates kernel-choice -> kv_hit_rate so on-call can detect silent regressions?

sam: yes, create metric runtime.kernel.selected + runtime.kv.hit_rate tagged by model+version. i'll wire it to the console dashboard.

anya: PRs incoming: conversion change (failsafe permute + header validation), runtime kernel selector guard, CI perf job. testplan includes explicit safetensors with swapped axes to emulate bad uploads.

evan: sounds good. timeline?

sam: i'll have the kernel guard PR by EOD. migration for existing converted blobs: add a cleanup job that re-runs conversion with stricter checks and writes an annotation in model metadata.

jie: i'll add the conversion heuristics and unit tests tomorrow.

miguel: assign me to the perf CI job and dashboard charts. i'm also going to add a small pprof snapshot collector during the perf run.

anya: thanks everyone. feel free to @me on PRs. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: deployment-notify: ticket #INF-982 created to track re-conversion of affected models.
